koenji.line: You are booking a room. The board is today's meeting room.
koenji.dates_line: You tapped today. The end is not chosen yet.
koenji.e_japanese: Japanese for parents and children. Book by phone; the desk does not take walk-ins that day

sagi.hours_line: You are looking up if the pool is open.
sagi.closed: Closed until 13:00. School swimming until then.
sagi.hours_body: The 25m tank is closed for the school block. Adult swim starts at 13:00. Last entry 20:30.
sagi.fees_body: Ward resident 200 yen. Other 600 yen. Locker 100 yen.
sagi.fees_caps: Swim caps are sold out at the desk. Bring your own.
sagi.access_walk: Seven minutes on foot from Saginomiya, south exit. The gate is past the ground, not the gym door.
sagi.access_bus: Nakano H02 stops at Saginomiya Station. Get off and walk the same way. There is no stop at the pool gate.
sagi.access_park: Eight parking spots. Full by 14:00 on Saturdays. No waiting on the school road.
sagi.access_bike: Bikes go on the rack by the ground. Do not lock to the fence; the office cuts those.
sagi.footer_gate: The number on the ward site is the sports office, not this gate.
sagi.footer_note: Closed Tuesdays and New Year week.
sagi.desk_line: Front desk. Lane sheet for today.
sagi.shift_line: First shift. The tape on the monitor is the keys.
sagi.woodin_note: 25m. Paid. No locker; bag on the bench.
sagi.toast_closed_body: School swimming until 13:00. Do not send people there.
sagi.tour_checkin_body: Mori is waiting. F2 does the same.
sagi.tour_closed_body: Lane 2 is closed for school until 13:00. Do not send people there.
sagi.key_checkin: Check in the person in the waiting row
